features.title: AgentKind enum + AgentKindPatterns table + Pane.agentKind/agentSessionID fields
features.preconditions: On feat/agent-state at HEAD 1a9d441 (planning docs committed). make mac-build is green. apps/mac/TouchCodeCore/Pane.swift is the existing Pane definition with id/workingDirectory/initialCommand/labels and a custom Codable that drops initialCommand on decode.
features.expected_behavior: TouchCodeCore now exports AgentKind (claude-code / codex / pi) and AgentKindPatterns.classify(initialCommand:title:notificationTitle:). Pane carries optional agentKind and agentSessionID, with Codable that round-trips a Pane carrying agentKind, and decodes an older fixture (no agentKind key) to nil. No catalog migration runs.
verification_steps: make mac-test ARGS="-only-testing:touch-codeTests/AgentKindPatternsTests" passes — at least three hit + three miss cases per AgentKind, plus a roundtrip Pane Codable test.

Manual: load an existing catalog.json fixture (one with no agentKind key) into a unit test, decode + encode, confirm the encoded JSON does not introduce an agentKind key (no spurious migration write).

features.title: HierarchyClient setPaneAgentKind / setPaneAgentSessionID + HierarchyManager writers
features.preconditions: T1 is committed (AgentKind + Pane fields exist). HierarchyClient struct currently exposes setPaneLabel etc.; HierarchyManager exposes labels writer with the standard debounced save pipeline.
features.expected_behavior: HierarchyClient gains setPaneAgentKind and setPaneAgentSessionID closures (live / unimplemented / test default all wired). HierarchyManager.setPaneAgentKind mutates Pane.agentKind and schedules a save only when the value actually changes; same shape for sessionID. Repeated writes of the same value are no-ops.
verification_steps: make mac-test ARGS="-only-testing:touch-codeTests/HierarchyManagerAgentIdentityTests" passes — covers (a) write reflects in snapshot, (b) repeat write does not schedule save, (c) write nil clears field.

features.title: AgentBinder — identify agent kind from initialCommand / title / OSC 9 banner
features.preconditions: T1 + T2 committed. RootFeature has the existing engineEventReceived chain that already routes paneInfoChanged / paneExited etc. SurfaceInfo exposes title and lastNotificationTitle; libghostty may or may not deliver paneInfoChanged(.promptEnd) — OQ-1 tracks that.
features.expected_behavior: A new @MainActor AgentBinder is wired up at AppState.bringUp. On pane creation it tries to classify from initialCommand; later title changes and OSC 9 banner events get a second pass; promptEnd is the only rebind trigger. paneExited / paneCrashed clear the binding. catalog.json starts carrying agentKind for panes that match the patterns.
verification_steps: make mac-test ARGS="-only-testing:touch-codeTests/AgentBinderTests" passes — covers initialCommand match, title-only match, sticky behaviour without prompt-end, rebind on prompt-end, paneExited unbind, no-match silence.

Manual: make mac-run-app; create a new tab via 'tc tab new --command claude' (or by simulating with printf '\e]2;Claude Code\a'); quit; jq '.. | objects | select(.agentKind?) | .agentKind' ~/.config/touch-code/catalog.json returns "claude-code".

features.title: AgentRegistry @Observable state machine + 12-case unit suite
features.preconditions: M1 committed. PaneKeyboardActivityTracker already exists. DetectionTranslator.classify already exists in TouchCodeCore.
features.expected_behavior: AgentRegistry exposes entries keyed by PaneID, each AgentEntry carrying kind / sessionID / state / lastTransitionAt. Inputs (runningPanes change, TerminalEvent, keyboard activity, focus, agent-bound/unbound) drive a private scratch (prevPhase / pendingFinished / waitingForInput) that derives the four-state output. Priority is waitingForInput > loading > finished > idle.
verification_steps: make mac-test ARGS="-only-testing:touch-codeTests/AgentRegistryStateTests" passes — at least 12 cases covering the transition table in design doc §Runtime State Derivation.

features.title: Cross-consumer consistency regression test
features.preconditions: T4 committed. NotificationDetector + DetectionTranslator already exist and consume TerminalEvent.
features.expected_behavior: A new integration test feeds an identical TerminalEvent sequence (OSC 9 → bell → OSC 9;4 busy → paneIdle → paneExited) to NotificationDetector and AgentRegistry and asserts both classify the same events consistently via DetectionTranslator.classify.

features.title: ActiveAgentsPopoverView + ActiveAgentsRowView + SortedEntriesProvider + headline view model

A separate ActiveAgentsBadgeViewModel produces the headline copy in the four shapes (empty / single / multi-same / multi-mixed).
verification_steps: make mac-test ARGS="-only-testing:touch-codeTests/ActiveAgentsBadgeViewModelTests" passes — four headline shapes.
make mac-test ARGS="-only-testing:touch-codeTests/ActiveAgentsRowSnapshotTests" passes — four states × light/dark.
